content: {"reasoning": "CPT 93229 requires prior authorization, which is missing, and this payer offers neither a retroactive-auth window nor peer-to-peer review. Submitting the claim (clean or with records) would only generate an auth-related denial that has no viable recourse, wasting touches, and no denial is yet on the table to support an appeal. Since the missing authorization is a provider-side failure with no available cure path and a Medicare Advantage enrollee cannot be balance-billed for it, the balance is uncollectible.", "action": "write_off"}
